definitions.gloss: boarding, getting on (a train, bus, car)
definitions.explanation: The act of getting on a ground vehicle such as a train, bus, or car.

examples.japanese: {乗車|じょうしゃ}⟦{拒否|きょひ}→拒否：08242_kyohi⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
{乗車|じょうしゃ}⟦{位置|いち}→位置：11554_ichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{黄色|きいろ}い→黄色い：00959_kiiroi⟧⟦{線|せん}→線：09901_sen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{内側|うちがわ}→内側：05449_uchigawa⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: The boarding position is inside the yellow line.

examples.english: Please buy a ticket before boarding.

notes:
USAGE: {乗車|じょうしゃ} is used for getting on trains, buses, and cars. For aircraft, use ⟦{搭乗|とうじょう}→搭乗：06200_toujou⟧ instead.

AS A SURU VERB: {乗車|じょうしゃ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to board)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{乗車券|じょうしゃけん}→乗車券：05298_joushaken⟧ (train ticket, boarding ticket)
- {乗車|じょうしゃ}⟦{位置|いち}→位置：11554_ichi⟧ (boarding position)
- {乗車|じょうしゃ}⟦{拒否|きょひ}→拒否：08242_kyohi⟧ (refusal of boarding)
- {乗車|じょうしゃ}⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧ (boarding time)
- {乗車|じょうしゃ}⟦{定員|ていいん}→定員：04532_teiin⟧ (passenger capacity)

ANTONYM: ⟦{降車|こうしゃ}→降車：20612_kousha⟧ (getting off, alighting)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{搭乗|とうじょう}→搭乗：06200_toujou⟧ - boarding (aircraft, ship)
- ⟦{下車|げしゃ}→下車：00068_gesha⟧ - alighting, getting off
